components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary user action within the portal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #237BB2; color: #FCFEFF; font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A6392; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(35,123,178,.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Portal Panel
components.description: Main task container on portal pages.
components.html:
我的 Key

安全管理访问凭据与用量。
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #D9E6EC; border-radius: 18px; background: #FCFEFF; color: #223842; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(34,56,64,.03), 0 12px 30px rgba(32,83,118,.04); font: 400 14px/1.65 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #60757D; }

narrative.overview: A calm, light workspace for API access. Distinction comes through restrained composition and thoughtful safety feedback, not decorative effects.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Use sky blue for actions and selection; use only lighter tints of the same hue for guidance backgrounds.

dos: Do make access management and safety guidance immediately understandable.
donts: Don't use the traditional dark-sidebar admin template as the portal identity.
